observation.command:
cd /opt
cp -r apache-tomcat-11.0.23 tomcat-dienste
cp -r apache-tomcat-11.0.23 tomcat-anwendung
cp -r apache-tomcat-11.0.23 tomcat-api
rm -rf apache-tomcat-11.0.23
# change ports: dienste 8080 (default), anwendung 8081, api 8082
sed -i 's/port="8080"/port="8081"/' tomcat-anwendung/conf/server.xml
sed -i 's/port="8005"/port="8006"/' tomcat-anwendung/conf/server.xml
sed -i 's/port="8080"/port="8082"/' tomcat-api/conf/server.xml
sed -i 's/port="8005"/port="8007"/' tomcat-api/conf/server.xml
# setenv.sh per guide (CATALINA_OPTS)
cat > tomcat-anwendung/bin/setenv.sh <<'EOF'
export CATALINA_OPTS='-DXPLANBOX_CONFIG=/opt/xplanbox/xplan-manager-config -DDEEGREE_WORKSPACE_ROOT=/opt/deegree -Djts.overlay=ng -Djavax.xml.transform.TransformerFactory=net.sf.saxon.TransformerFactoryImpl -Duser.timezone=Europe/Berlin'
export JAVA_OPTS='-Xmx4096m'
EOF
cat > tomcat-dienste/bin/setenv.sh <<'EOF'
export CATALINA_OPTS='-DDEEGREE_WORKSPACE_ROOT=/opt/deegree -Djavax.xml.transform.TransformerFactory=net.sf.saxon.TransformerFactoryImpl'
export JAVA_OPTS='-Xmx4096m'
EOF
cat > tomcat-api/bin/setenv.sh <<'EOF'
export CATALINA_OPTS='-DXPLANBOX_CONFIG=/opt/xplanbox/xplan-manager-config -DDEEGREE_WORKSPACE_ROOT=/opt/deegree -Djts.overlay=ng -Djavax.xml.transform.TransformerFactory=net.sf.saxon.TransformerFactoryImpl -Duser.timezone=Europe/Berlin'
export JAVA_OPTS='-Xmx4096m'
EOF
chmod +x tomcat-*/bin/setenv.sh
ls -d tomcat-*; echo done
